item_name: Rothco G.I. Style Canvas Butt Pack
item_short_desc: Enhance your outdoor gear with Rothco's Canvas Butt Pack, a reliable storage solution for your tactical and hiking adventures. Constructed from durable heavyweight canvas, this butt pack offers ample space to carry your essential items, measuring 9 inch x 8.5 inch x 6 inch. The dual ALICE keeper clips on the back ensure a secure attachment to your duty belt, ALICE pack system, or other tactical gear. For added versatility, the outdoor pack includes 2 canvas tabs with grommet holes, allowing you to attach it to a harness.
description: Enhance your outdoor gear with Rothco's Canvas Butt Pack, a reliable storage solution for your tactical and hiking adventures.
